scope: Document structure, source traceability, independent AI review, static screen/diagram rendering only

targetDocuments.path: sample-project2/spec/Access/詳細仕様書/06_汎用コードマスタ画面.md

reviewScope.originalInputs: Each method only: project information, original QA, requirements, basic F01-F06/logical tables/codes, common UI/check/data/initial/Pilot documents. No other project business, source, spec-eval, whole-project specs or real DB was read.
coverage: All 6 functions and 17 events per method; 83 item-to-physical mappings per method
Current authentication/ADMIN-STAFF authority/lock and idle boundaries
Search invalidation/4 conditions/no paging/200 and 201 results
Parent-child save/20 careers/loaded-kept-removed sets/stopped-code exception/revision and commit outcomes
5 tables and 48 original field IDs per method; physical types/capacity/NULL/defaults/PK-FK-UQ/UTC/parameters/gates
Two-sheet full-text report/snapshot date/ownership/re-authorization/Access completed-file versus Web response start
Original SP2-DEMO-01 keys/counts/order/password handling/idempotency; adopted versus approved decisions and pending validation
reviewScope.excludedVerification: Parent separately verifies structure, links, Mermaid parsing/rendering, embedded HTML/report identity and visual artifacts. This PASS claims document semantics only.

resolvedFindings.finding: Win64/UI API details were incomplete or assumed a nonexistent TextBox property.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reserved PBKDF2 flags=0, MsgWait queue result=1 with unchanged deadline, and Access Change/BeforeUpdate scalar validation without MaxLength are explicit.

resolvedFindings.finding: F01 current-row read appeared before BeginTrans.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Gate and private Workspace BeginTrans precede current authentication row retrieval.

resolvedFindings.finding: Menu Form_Load and feature-click transition shared an ambiguous entry contract.
resolvedFindings.resolution: RefreshMenu performs current authorization/display only with zero transitions; OpenFeature runs from allowed button clicks.

resolvedFindings.finding: First input after idle expiry could refresh the tick before expiry evaluation.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Input handlers and RequireCurrent evaluate the previous tick first; expired input never refreshes authentication.

resolvedFindings.finding: vbTextCompare could broaden search equality through host linguistic collation.
resolvedFindings.resolution: NFKC/space removal/invariant uppercase key generation is followed by vbBinaryCompare; raw business text is retained.

resolvedFindings.finding: F06 Unknown cancellation/menu and ordinary new cancellation states were incomplete.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Unknown permits only confirmed current-value reload; ordinary new cancellation exits edit mode, clears selection and disables input/save.

resolvedFindings.finding: Synchronous export cancellation lacked an input-to-flag/event-pump contract.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Existing F03 Esc/Unload sets the owned cancellation flag; guarded DoEvents checkpoints are outside DB gate/transaction and file-move calls.

resolvedFindings.finding: 512KiB could reject maximum legal escaped Unicode input.
resolvedFindings.resolution: 2MiB body, explicit form count/value and JSON depth limits cover approximately 82200 scalars at worst 12-byte escaped representation plus framing.

resolvedFindings.finding: ClosedXML 0.105.1 Value setter removes one leading literal apostrophe.
resolvedFindings.resolution: SetTextExact compensates only leading apostrophes through public Value then clears IncludeQuotePrefix; immediate/readback exact comparison and unperformed runtime cases are explicit.

resolvedFindings.finding: Authentication decision UTC was fixed before the gate wait.
resolvedFindings.resolution: UTC is captured once after Exclusive gate acquisition for lock expiry and fifth-failure lock duration.

resolvedFindings.finding: Automatic verifier rehash contradicted original F01 two-column update scope.
resolvedFindings.resolution: SuccessRehashNeeded is accepted as successful verification without password_verifier writes; F01 SQL/common/DB/DQA retain failed_count and locked_until updates only.

resolvedFindings.finding: Generic ICommand/ViewModel placeholders did not specify MVC bindings/types.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Item extensions name actual VM properties, nullable strings/enums or button Controller.Action/routes; MenuVm.CurrentRole is UserRole.

resolvedFindings.finding: Draft confirmation DTOs and browser-to-server export cancellation were underspecified.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Action/fields/confirmation kinds and choices/one-use IDs plus minimum VMs are fixed; owned CTS cancellation POST, RequestAborted/AbortController and startup-phase race handling are defined.

resolvedFindings.finding: F05 selected employee ID was incorrectly bound to department name and related combined fields were inaccurate.
resolvedFindings.resolution: I04 is allowed EmployeeId string-to-long/non-output; I02 includes number and department; I05 separates non-output status/code names; I12 maps company only.

resolvedFindings.finding: F06 cancellation restored stale Snapshot and did not clearly stop Unknown menu/cancel.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current ADMIN and current composite-key row are retrieved before replacing the original; Unknown permits only confirmed explicit reload.

resolvedFindings.finding: DB authentication error mapping could expose MSG020/017 contrary to original uniform MSG001.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Internal Integrity/DB/Unknown remain distinct but Controller/LoginVm maps all F01 read/commit/control failures outward to MSG001 without Cookie issuance.

resolvedFindings.finding: F04-E03 flow collapsed failed save into full rollback and omitted explicit commit/rollback unknown branches.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The diagram now checks the current parent version before differences, preserves revision/time/actor with MSG021 for no change, stops real changes at version limit with MSG039, and separates confirmed commit MSG014, confirmed rollback/cause message or MSG017, and unconfirmed commit/rollback MSG034 with save disabled and confirmed reload only. Pre-write authorization failure explicitly discards unsaved data and returns to F01 on expiry; ordinary errors retain input.
resolvedFindings.reviewScope: Only revised F04-E03 Mermaid flow versus existing event procedure/result text was rereviewed. Original requirement/basic files and the other 29 reviewed documents were not reread or edited.
